details:
A way to set two independent variables on one menu toggle would really help me and my workflow out.

Recently I've been making avatars that have a lot of customization via material swaps and shapekeys. Problem is, I use a slightly unique method to do so.

I use motion time to create an index using floats, to get all my avatar's customization options using only 1 animation.

This makes adding new toggles extremely easy as I don't have to add back and forth conditional branches and can instead just add a new frame in my animation and toggle to my menu. However due to the 1/64 accuracy sync for positive floats, I'm actually hitting a limit soon.

While it works for now, if I ever want to go beyond that, I'd need to make an animation tree that has 65+ individual animations and branches via integer conditions.

If I had the option to tie a second variable when a player hits a single toggle button could let me, and others, do a variety of things.

-Having the float indexing method, and a secondary integer to have a 2d array of available animations with much less branching conditions overall

-Reset a separate toggle when a player enables something that's conflicts with some other feature

-'Preset' toggles would be simpler for newer creators to set up (But might need more considerations, so secondary variables will either reset when any of the variables are changes, or the toggle is treated as a one-way)
title: Two parameters on menu Toggles
